## Wacom Intuos Pro Medium (2025)

Designed primarily for beginner to intermediate users, the Wacom Intuos Pro Medium (2025) offers the versatility to create detailed illustrations, designs and photographs. The included Wacom Pro Pen 3 can be fully customised to your preferences and never needs recharging. The tablet's 263 x 148 mm active area has a 16:9 aspect ratio, making it easier to match movements with complementary monitors. With Bluetooth 5.3 support, you have the freedom to place and rotate the Intuos Pro almost anywhere as needed without tangling. Or you can connect the Intuos Pro directly to your Windows 10 or macOS 13 or later computer with the included USB-C to USB-A cable to charge the internal 1200 mAh battery while you work. Customisable ExpressKeys and two radial dials help speed up your creative workflow. Streamline your workflow with ten customisable ExpressKeys that can be programmed with shortcuts and commonly used functions. Use the two radial dials to perform functions such as zooming and changing brush sizes. The included Wacom Pro Pen 3 delivers 8192 levels of pressure sensitivity with 60° tilt; and also has up to three side buttons. It can also be customised with the included grips, changing inserts and weights to suit your specific preferences. Switch between the included tips for different levels of friction. Using electromagnetic resonance technology, this pen does not require charging. Avoid interruptions with up to 16 hours of battery life. The internal lithium-ion battery can be charged quickly in about two hours, or about 3.5 hours with normal charging.
